say: Mariano's collector 1.10.0rc6 (commit d77f306), recorded on Hamza's own Azure test VM (Ubuntu 24.04),
not on the client's VM. Store: Mariano's Vernon Hills 53100502, PICKUP. Provider: Oxylabs Web API,
the credit Hamza supplied, every submission reserved in its own spending ledger before it is sent.
Every command below runs for real while it is recorded; nothing is edited afterwards. The published
copy masks private identifiers (host name, paths) and nothing else.
The run shown is the logical full-scope run 01M7KQ5GZVF5VK1S9FGTG6YFC9, read in slices; this is the slice M-R7w-walkthrough-110rc6-20261117.
The run as the collector records it: interrupted by the operator's SIGTERM that ended the previous slice,
resumable.
The spending ledger of this credit: hash chain, active lease, what Mariano's can still spend.

argv: mstage6 ledger-status | python3 -I -c 'import json,sys; d=json.load(sys.stdin); m=d["projects"]["marianos"]; print("chain", d["chain"], "| lease", d["active_lease"], "| Mariano\x27s committed", m["committed_usd"], "| spendable", m["spendable_in_envelope_usd"], "| held unknown", m["unknown_rows"], "rows")'

say: Resume the run as a service (it survives a lost SSH session), two lanes, and follow its log. After 12 pages
it is stopped with SIGTERM (systemctl stop): the collector records a resumable stop (exit 75).
A second start for the store while it has an unfinished run is refused before any request: the harness
gives it a gate that refuses every submission, and none is even attempted (exit 9).
Resume again, with the slice stopper beside it: the run goes on until this slice's stage holds 100 reservations
in the ledger (then SIGTERM: exit 75, resumable), or until the run itself ends, whichever comes first.
Pages completed before the stop are not asked again.

steps.cmd: SLICE_TARGET=100 run_and_follow6.sh marianos-stage-r7w-2 M-R7w-walkthrough-110rc6-20261117 resume --store marianos-53100502-pickup

say: An attempt to publish the run as it now stands (only a complete run whose gates pass is published;
anything else is refused with exit 6 and the published dataset is left as it was):
The coverage of the CSV rows, when the run has ended and exported its records:

argv: if [ -f /var/lib/marianos-collector/rc5/data/runs/marianos-53100502-pickup/01M7KQ5GZVF5VK1S9FGTG6YFC9/exports/manifest.json ]; then python3 -I /var/lib/marianos-collector/ops-rc6/walk/tools/show.py coverage /var/lib/marianos-collector/rc5/data/runs/marianos-53100502-pickup/01M7KQ5GZVF5VK1S9FGTG6YFC9/exports; else echo 'no export yet: the run is interrupted and resumable, and exports its records when it ends'; fi

say: Records traced to the stored page they were read from (its SHA-256 checked), and the tile read again
independently of the collector, when the run has exported them:

argv: if [ -f /var/lib/marianos-collector/rc5/data/runs/marianos-53100502-pickup/01M7KQ5GZVF5VK1S9FGTG6YFC9/exports/manifest.json ]; then sudo -u marianos /opt/marianos-collector/current/venv/bin/python -I /var/lib/marianos-collector/ops-rc6/walk/tools/trace_record.py /var/lib/marianos-collector/rc5/data/runs/marianos-53100502-pickup/01M7KQ5GZVF5VK1S9FGTG6YFC9/exports /var/lib/marianos-collector/rc5/data 0084024314377 0001280052496 0001780014939 0001780014941 0002310014848 0003980014995; else echo 'no export yet: nothing to trace'; fi
